title: Staff
description: The operators who can reach this panel.

password.label: Initial password
password.description: Leave this empty to email them an invitation instead. If you type one, hand it over out of band — nothing forces a change at first sign-in.

roles.label: Roles
roles.description: At least one. Granting super admin is refused unless you are one.

create.title: New staff member
create.description: Leave the password empty and they are emailed an invitation to choose their own; type one and they can sign in as soon as this is saved.

edit.title: Edit {{email}}
edit.description: The email address is not a field here — changing the identifier a session was established with is its own flow, below.

delete.title: Delete {{email}}?
delete.description: The account and its role grants are deleted outright. This cannot be undone.

bulkDelete.description: The accounts and their role grants are deleted outright. This cannot be undone. Some may be refused — the last super admin, an account that outranks you, or your own — and you will be told which.

resendInvitation.title: Resend the invitation to {{email}}?
resendInvitation.description: A new link goes to that address and the previous one stops working. Only an operator who has not set a password yet can be sent one.

revokeSessions.title: Sign {{email}} out everywhere?
revokeSessions.description: Every session of this account ends immediately. The account itself is unchanged and they can sign in again.

resetPassword.title: Reset the password for {{email}}
resetPassword.description: They stay signed out until they use the new password. Nothing forces them to change it afterwards.

password.label: New password
password.description: Hand it over out of band. Every session of this account is signed out.

currentPassword.label: Your own current password
currentPassword.description: Confirms it is you making the change, not a stolen session.

changeEmail.title: Change the address for {{email}}
changeEmail.description: The address changes as soon as you save. Nothing is mailed and nothing is confirmed — you are the confirmation. Their sessions are untouched, and they sign in to this panel with the new address from now on.

email.label: New email address
email.description: It must not belong to another operator.

currentPassword.label: Your own current password
currentPassword.description: Confirms it is you making the change, not a stolen session.

outcomes.passwordReset: The password was reset and every session of that account was signed out.
outcomes.sessionsRevoked: Every session of that account was signed out.
